# Mouse into panes (C5.3): with tmux's default mouse bindings, a program that asked for the
# mouse gets clicks, drags, the wheel and motion at its own coordinates, encoded as it asked
# (1000, 1002 or 1003; 1006 or 1005 or neither); one that did not gets nothing. The fake TUI
# appends what it reads to evN.out as hex; z ends each round. "run run-shell -d 0.4" waits out
# the click timeout (300 ms) between presses, so each starts a new click sequence.
size 80x24
run new-session -d -s a 'exec cat'
client c 80x24
# x10
run respawn-pane -k -t %0 'faketui -mode keys -init "\x1b[?1000h" -out ev0.out'
waittext %0 'key READY'
run display-message -p '#{mouse_any_flag}|#{mouse_standard_flag}|#{mouse_button_flag}|#{mouse_all_flag}|#{mouse_sgr_flag}|#{mouse_utf8_flag}'
type c '\x1b[<0;11;6M'
type c '\x1b[<0;11;6m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<2;21;4M'
type c '\x1b[<2;21;4m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<0;6;6M'
type c '\x1b[<32;8;6M'
type c '\x1b[<32;9;7M'
type c '\x1b[<0;9;7m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<64;30;10M'
type c '\x1b[<65;30;10M'
type c '\x1b[<35;40;12M'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c z
waittext %0 '7a'
run run-shell 'tr -d "\\n" < ev0.out; echo'
# sgr
run respawn-pane -k -t %0 'faketui -mode keys -init "\x1b[?1000h\x1b[?1006h" -out ev1.out'
waittext %0 'key READY'

run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<2;21;4M'
type c '\x1b[<2;21;4m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<0;6;6M'
type c '\x1b[<32;8;6M'
type c '\x1b[<32;9;7M'
type c '\x1b[<0;9;7m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<64;30;10M'
type c '\x1b[<65;30;10M'
type c '\x1b[<35;40;12M'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c z

run run-shell 'tr -d "\\n" < ev1.out; echo'

run kill-server
